mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,fencing_epoch,run_id,high_water_updated_at, high_water_sla_clock_id,expires_at,state,last_error_code, lock_version,created_at,updated_at FROM sla_index_rebuild_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,fencing_epoch,run_id,high_water_updated_at, high_water_sla_clock_id,expires_at,state,last_error_code, lock_version,created_at,updated_at FROM sla_index_rebuild_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_index_rebuild_lease (tenant_id,fencing_epoch,state,created_at,updated_at,updated_by_type) VALUES (#{tenantId},0,'IDLE',#{now},#{now2},'SCHEDULER') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE sla_index_rebuild_lease SET fencing_epoch=fencing_epoch+1,run_id=#{runId},high_water_updated_at=#{highWaterAt}, high_water_sla_clock_id=#{highWaterClockId},expires_at=#{expiresAt},state='RUNNING',last_error_code=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SCHEDULER' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ( state='IDLE' OR (state='DEGRADED' AND run_id IS NULL) OR (state IN ('RUNNING','CATCHING_UP','SWAPPING','DEGRADED') AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < #{now2}) )
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM sla_index_rebuild_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND state IN ('RUNNING','CATCHING_UP','SWAPPING') AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > #{now} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sla_index_rebuild_lease SET state=#{state},expires_at=#{expiresAt},last_error_code=#{errorCode}, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SCHEDULER',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND fencing_epoch=#{fencingEpoch} AND state <> 'IDLE' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > #{now2}
